projects.title: LuRETools: Reverse Engineering Suite
projects.description: Developed a C-based utility suite for parsing Windows PE and Linux ELF headers. Implemented direct memory access routines to identify binary compatibility anomalies and embedded metadata without source code access.

projects.title: cage: Minimal Linux Sandbox and Syscall Monitor
projects.description: Built a Linux sandbox using namespaces, cgroups, seccomp-BPF, and ptrace to isolate processes and monitor syscall behavior. Implemented process containment with custom filesystem isolation and syscall filtering.

projects.title: WannaCry & EternalBlue: Kernel-Mode Exploit Chain Analysis
projects.description: Reverse engineered the EternalBlue SMB exploit (CVE-2017-0144). Analyzed kernel-mode buffer overflows, process hollowing techniques, and AES+RSA encryption procedures used for mutex-based persistence.

projects.title: LL-Inj: Link-Layer Packet Replay & Injection Framework
projects.description: Built a low-latency packet injection tool using raw sockets. Focused on real-time header modification (MAC/IP/TCP SEQ) and checksum recalculation for synchronous replay attacks.

projects.title: Pcap-Parser: Non-blocking Network Traffic Analysis
projects.description: Implemented a high-performance PCAP processor in C to analyze link-layer protocols and reconstruct network flows for forensic analysis.

projects.title: BufOvf: Automated Payload Generation for x86/x64
projects.description: Developed a toolset for automating the generation of buffer overflow payloads. Researched mitigation bypassing techniques including ROP-chain synthesis and stack canary exhaustion.

projects.title: AFL++ Fuzzing Campaigns
projects.description: Configured and ran AFL++ fuzzing campaigns against real-world C/C++ targets including tcpdump, xpdf, and minizip-ng. Practiced corpus minimization, sanitizer builds, crash reproduction, and triage workflows.
